newForms.name: Geodrift
newForms.lore: Rolls downhill on purpose now, just to hear the crystals inside chime.

newForms.name: Geodolem
newForms.lore: Stands up on stubby crystal legs for the first time and immediately trips over a pebble.

newForms.name: Geodwarden
newForms.lore: Grew arms out of raw quartz and appointed itself guardian of the vein it hatched in.

newForms.name: Geodsovereign
newForms.lore: Every geode in Glimmer Hollows quietly agrees this one is in charge.

newForms.name: Glintfox
newForms.lore: Sparks now jump between its ears when it's excited, which is always.

newForms.name: Fulgorfox
newForms.lore: Outran its own shadow once. The shadow still hasn't caught up.

newForms.name: Prismfox
newForms.lore: Its fur throws small rainbows across the Hollows whenever lightning hits nearby crystal.

newForms.name: Fulgurmane
newForms.lore: A living thunderbolt with a fox's grin; the Hollows' updrafts bend just to keep pace with it.

newForms.name: Shardfang
newForms.lore: Its bite now leaves crystal splinters behind, and it never bites just once.

newForms.name: Shardhowler
newForms.lore: Howls once, and every loose geode in the Hollows answers with a hum.

newForms.name: Quartzmaw
newForms.lore: Runs the high ridges in a pack of one; its own teeth are argument enough.

newForms.name: Shardking
newForms.lore: The biggest geode veins in the Hollows all have the same set of claw marks nearby.

newForms.name: Prismwing
newForms.lore: Its wingbeats now split cave-light into tiny rainbows across the ceiling.

newForms.name: Chromawing
newForms.lore: Roosts upside down, humming a different colour of light every night.

newForms.name: Radiantwing
newForms.lore: Lights entire crystal chambers just by stretching its wings.

newForms.name: Luxwing
newForms.lore: The old miners say if you see its true colours, you've found the richest vein in the Hollows.

newForms.name: Quartzhide
newForms.lore: Its back plates thicken into slabs of raw quartz; shrugging off boulders is now a party trick.

newForms.name: Quartzridge
newForms.lore: A walking crystal ridge that miners quietly follow, hoping it stops somewhere valuable.

newForms.name: Quartzbastion
newForms.lore: Stands between danger and the herd without being asked twice.

newForms.name: Quartzmonarch
newForms.lore: The oldest, heaviest plates in Glimmer Hollows all grew on this one back.

newForms.name: Thunderfang
newForms.lore: Bites down and the air itself cracks like a whip.

newForms.name: Tempestmane
newForms.lore: Its mane crackles with a storm it hasn't quite let loose yet.

newForms.name: Skyfang
newForms.lore: Runs so fast along ridgelines that thunder arrives a full second late.

newForms.name: Tempestlord
newForms.lore: When it howls at the summit, every cloud for miles turns to listen.

newForms.name: Squallray
newForms.lore: Rides the storm-fronts in over the Hollows, always a beat ahead of the thunder.

newForms.name: Thunderfin
newForms.lore: Its wingtips spark when it banks hard through a cloud.

newForms.name: Zephyrmanta
newForms.lore: Glides for entire days on nothing but stolen static.

newForms.name: Maelray
newForms.lore: A living storm-front; ships and Wayfarers alike just get out of its way.

newForms.name: Haloglow
newForms.lore: Its ring of light steadies, just enough to read by on the darkest ledges.

newForms.name: Sanctilume
newForms.lore: Lost climbers say a warm light finds them right before the cold does.

newForms.name: Seraphume
newForms.lore: Hovers over the summit shrines at dawn like it's still keeping a promise.

newForms.name: Empyrion
newForms.lore: Some say it's what's left of a Sky Warden's kindness, still making its rounds.

newForms.name: Wardenwraith
newForms.lore: Still walks the same ten paces of ruined hallway it swore to guard, centuries ago.

newForms.name: Sentinelshade
newForms.lore: Salutes any climber who bows first. It has excellent memory for manners.

newForms.name: Highward
newForms.lore: Stands at the last gate before the summit and has never once let the weather in.

newForms.name: Duskwarden
newForms.lore: The Sky Wardens are gone. This is the part of their oath that refused to be.

prompts.name: Geodgloop
prompts.prompt: A small round mossy-green blob with a cracked-open geode embedded in its back, violet crystal facets glittering through the gap and a faint icy-blue glow at the core; big curious eyes peek out beneath the crystal crown.

prompts.name: Geodrift
prompts.prompt: A slightly larger lump-shaped blob, more of its rubbery hide replaced by cracked violet crystal plates fused down its spine, with tiny quartz nubs sprouting like knees; the same glow-blue core now peeks through two more seams.

prompts.name: Geodolem
prompts.prompt: The blob rises onto four short crystal stumps, its body now half rock half jelly, deep amethyst geode facets ringing a wider cracked crown on its head, glowing pale-blue light pulsing between the seams.

prompts.name: Geodwarden
prompts.prompt: A hulking crystal golem shape now dominates, jelly visible only in glowing seams between huge violet geode slabs armoured across its back and shoulders, sky-blue light blazing from its chest core like a lantern.

prompts.name: Geodsovereign
prompts.prompt: A towering geode colossus, its whole body an ornate cathedral of deep-violet crystal spires and shelves crowned in a jagged quartz halo, brilliant blue-white light pouring from countless seams as if lit from within.

prompts.name: Glimfox
prompts.prompt: A sleek indigo-blue fox with a single sharp storm-crystal shard jutting from its brow and small cyan sparks crackling along its tail-tip; alert amber eyes, lean athletic build.

prompts.name: Glintfox
prompts.prompt: A slightly leaner, faster-looking fox, two crystal shards now framing its brow like small antennae, its tail fur tipped in bright cyan static that visibly crackles.

prompts.name: Fulgorfox
prompts.prompt: A wiry storm-fox with a crest of jagged indigo crystal running down its spine, front paws sparking with restless energy, its four-shard brow-crown glowing brighter cyan.

prompts.name: Prismfox
prompts.prompt: A tall, rangy fox wrapped in a mane of crystal shards that splits stray light into small rainbows, its whole coat deepened to near-black indigo, eyes blazing electric cyan.

prompts.name: Fulgurmane
prompts.prompt: A majestic storm-fox with a flowing mane of fused lightning-crystal spines that arcs and glows white-cyan with contained thunder, deep midnight-indigo fur, and a piercing gaze that seems to crackle.

prompts.name: Shardmaw
prompts.prompt: A lean grey-violet wolf with jagged amethyst crystal shards bristling along its spine and jaw, lilac glow lighting the cracks in its teeth; sharp predatory eyes.

prompts.name: Shardfang
prompts.prompt: A slightly bulkier crystal wolf, more shards now fused along its jaw into a jagged crystalline muzzle, its spine-crest thicker and glowing a richer lavender.

prompts.name: Shardhowler
prompts.prompt: A powerful wolf whose whole back bristles with a ridge of long amethyst crystal blades, deep slate-violet fur, muzzle wreathed in glowing lavender light when it howls.

prompts.name: Quartzmaw
prompts.prompt: A large, muscular crystal wolf built to be ridden, its spine-blades grown into a towering armoured crest, deep charcoal-violet fur, jaw and crest glowing bright lilac-white.

prompts.name: Shardking
prompts.prompt: A magnificent alpha crystal wolf, nearly black-violet fur beneath an immense crown of fused amethyst blades from skull to tail, every shard blazing radiant white-lavender light.

prompts.name: Prismbat
prompts.prompt: A small violet-blue bat with a single glinting crystal shard for a nose-leaf and pale cyan-lit wing membranes threaded with faint light-lines; big round curious eyes.

prompts.name: Prismwing
prompts.prompt: A slightly bigger bat with two small crystal shards flanking its nose, its thin wing membranes now shimmering with visible rainbow refractions along the veins, deepened indigo fur.

prompts.name: Chromawing
prompts.prompt: A sleek violet bat whose wing membranes have become stained-glass panes of shifting colour, a crown of small crystal spikes along its head, eyes glowing bright cyan.

prompts.name: Radiantwing
prompts.prompt: A striking bat with broad prism-glass wings that scatter full rainbows in flight, a ridge of luminous crystal spines down its back, deep indigo fur fading almost to black, wings edged in bright light.

prompts.name: Luxwing
prompts.prompt: A radiant crystal bat whose vast stained-glass wings blaze with captured light in every colour, an elaborate crown of fused prism spires on its head, deep near-black indigo fur, and eyes like twin lanterns.

prompts.name: Quartzback
prompts.prompt: A sturdy stegosaur-like creature with lavender-grey hide and a row of pale quartz plates down its spine, each one glowing faint sky-blue at the base; broad calm face, thick stocky legs.

prompts.name: Quartzhide
prompts.prompt: A slightly bulkier stegosaur with its spinal plates now solid milky quartz, glowing a brighter blue where they meet its lavender hide, thicker armoured legs.

prompts.name: Quartzridge
prompts.prompt: A broad-backed tank whose quartz plates have grown into a jagged ridge from neck to tail, each plate glowing pale blue, hide deepened to dusky violet-grey.

prompts.name: Quartzbastion
prompts.prompt: A massive armoured quartz-back with towering plate formations fused into overlapping shield-shelves, deep violet hide, plates blazing near-white with inner light.

prompts.name: Quartzmonarch
prompts.prompt: An immense crystal-armoured colossus whose spine carries a cathedral of fused quartz plates crowned at the shoulders, deep amethyst hide, every seam blazing brilliant white-blue light like a living geode.

prompts.name: Stormhowl
prompts.prompt: A pale storm-white wolf with a crackling mane of pale-gold static and sharp lightning-blue eyes, lean muscular build built for the high ridgelines.

prompts.name: Thunderfang
prompts.prompt: A slightly larger storm-white wolf, its mane now visibly forked with small lightning branches, fangs glinting faint gold, storm-blue eyes narrowed and fierce.

prompts.name: Tempestmane
prompts.prompt: A powerful wolf whose entire mane has become a crown of living static arcs in pale gold, coat deepening toward a stormy blue-white, muscular chest built for the charge.

prompts.name: Skyfang
prompts.prompt: A tall, rangy storm-wolf wreathed in crackling lightning that runs constantly along its spine and legs, mane blazing near-white gold, eyes like twin bolts.

prompts.name: Tempestlord
prompts.prompt: A majestic storm-wolf the size of a summit boulder, its whole mane and tail a permanent corona of blinding white-gold lightning, deep storm-blue coat rippling with static, eyes burning like the eye of a thunderhead.

prompts.name: Stormray
prompts.prompt: A flat, wide indigo manta-ray-like creature gliding with wing-fins tipped in pale storm-gold, small sparks flickering off its trailing tail, bright alert eyes on a smooth rounded head.

prompts.name: Squallray
prompts.prompt: A slightly broader indigo ray with brighter gold static crackling along its wing edges, its tail now trailing a faint spark-trail as it glides.

prompts.name: Thunderfin
prompts.prompt: A sleek deep-indigo ray whose wing-fins have grown longer and sharper, laced with visible branching lightning along the leading edge, gold sparks streaming off every wingbeat.

prompts.name: Zephyrmanta
prompts.prompt: A large glowing ray, deep near-black indigo, its vast wings now edged in a constant crown of crackling gold-white lightning, twin light-trails streaming from its wingtips in flight.

prompts.name: Maelray
prompts.prompt: An immense storm-ray gliding like a living thundercloud, deep indigo-black body wreathed head to tail in blinding white-gold lightning arcs, wings so wide they seem to blot out the sky behind them.

prompts.name: Haloling
prompts.prompt: A small pale ghost-light drifting in a soft cream-gold glow, a thin halo ring floating just above it, faint wisps trailing like a candle flame; two gentle glowing eyes.

prompts.name: Haloglow
prompts.prompt: A slightly larger drifting ghost-light, its halo ring now solid and brighter gold, its cream-white form trailing longer wisps of warm light.

prompts.name: Sanctilume
prompts.prompt: A softly glowing spirit with a wider, more defined golden halo and two smaller light-rings orbiting its trailing wisps, its form a richer warm gold-cream.

prompts.name: Seraphume
prompts.prompt: An elegant light-spirit wreathed in three nested golden halo rings and long trailing streamers of warm light, its glowing core now a deep radiant gold.

prompts.name: Empyrion
prompts.prompt: A magnificent being of layered golden halos and streaming light-wings, its core blazing like a captured sunrise, trailing warmth and soft radiance in every direction.

prompts.name: Wardenshade
prompts.prompt: A tall spectral armoured warrior, pale blue-white plate armour over a translucent ghostly frame, wielding a glowing cyan blade, faint mist trailing from its cloak; steady glowing eyes beneath a worn helm.

prompts.name: Wardenwraith
prompts.prompt: A slightly taller spectral knight, its pale armour now etched with faint glowing cyan runes, cloak trailing longer wisps of mist, blade burning a touch brighter.

prompts.name: Sentinelshade
prompts.prompt: An imposing armoured spirit with a more ornate pale helm and pauldrons traced in glowing cyan sigils, its whole form more solid yet still edged in drifting mist, blade wreathed in light.

prompts.name: Highward
prompts.prompt: A towering armoured guardian spirit in elaborate pale-violet plate etched entirely in luminous cyan sigils, a long ghostly cloak streaming like banners, blade blazing bright and steady.

prompts.name: Duskwarden
prompts.prompt: A magnificent spectral warden in resplendent violet-silver armour wreathed in glowing cyan runes from helm to greaves, a vast trailing cloak of living mist, and a blade that burns like captured starlight.
